CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Ten Commandments has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Ten Commandments.
   D. Use The Ten Commandments to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Jacob Wrestles an Angel? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jacob Wrestles an Angel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jacob Wrestles an Angel.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jacob Wrestles an Angel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Jacob Wrestles an Angel has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Miracle of Healing? (1 mark)
   A. Say Miracle of Healing has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracle of Healing.
   C. Apply the teaching of Miracle of Healing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Miracle of Healing to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Faith in God Elisha? (1 mark)
   A. Say Faith in God Elisha has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Faith in God Elisha to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Faith in God Elisha with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith in God Elisha.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Temptations of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Temptations of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Temptations of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Temptations of Jesus Christ.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.
   B. Use My Purpose to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My Purpose has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Say Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inspired Word of God.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Leisure? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leisure.
   C. Say Leisure has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Leisure to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines has no place in daily life.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Inspired Word of God and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Ten Commandments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Faith in God Elisha and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. C — Apply the teaching of Jacob Wrestles an Angel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Apply the teaching of Miracle of Healing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Faith in God Elisha with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. C — Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. D — Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Inspired Word of God; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Ten Commandments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Faith in God Elisha; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
